我们在 OpenAI 网站上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现，研究人员对人工智能的使用量正在呈指数级增长，智能助手能够完成更长的任务，但人类在研究中的参与仍然至关重要。此外，研究人员在安全性和相关事务上的投入时间也在不断增加。

posts.text: We’re sharing how we approach safety at every stage of a model’s lifecycle, from early research to internal use to public deployment.
posts.quoted: A lot has happened in the past couple months, to say the least. Today we are sharing a recap of what it takes to move a frontier model from training to internal use to public release. As model capabilities rise, so do the safety and alignment standards required to move forward
